name: FUN_DOCIO_AL_RAGS
description: This table constains Retrieval-Augmented Generation sources to help producing more accurate and contextually relevant transformation mappings. These sources may include predefined metadata associated with the source structure, target structure, and transformation mapping. They can also encompass runtime-learned contexts or custom-defined contexts.

columns.name: RAG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) source.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_HASH
columns.description: Indicates the code of the document.

columns.name: USECASE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the usecase.

columns.name: PROMPT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the prompt template.

columns.name: PROMPT_TMPL_VERSION
columns.description: Indicates the version for the prompt template.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CONTENT
columns.description: Content of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) document.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) source is active.

columns.name: DOC_VERSION
columns.description: Indicates the version of the RAG document.

columns.name: DOC_PK1_VALUE
columns.description: Identifier for the RAG document persisted to UCM.

columns.name: DOC_PK2_VALUE
columns.description: Alternate Identifier for the RAG document persisted to UCM.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
